notes:
User is planning their week and uses Todoist for task management, with interest in productivity organization, prioritization, reminders, progress tracking, and goals. Gym routine is on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays; they now describe heading to the gym around 6:00 pm on meeting days. For recurring reminders, specific weekdays are preferable to “every 2 days.” They are interested in managing multiple simultaneous projects; useful Todoist methods include projects, cross-project labels, filters, priorities, sections, subtasks, and regular reviews. For goals, break outcomes into measurable tasks and track completion counts, deadlines, and project progress.

They plan to meet a potential client on Tuesday at 2:00 pm, preferably for about 60 minutes or less, leaving time afterward to get to the gym by 6:00 pm. Before the meeting, they will send the client a Google Drive folder containing prepared files via email. The email should include a brief note, review request, meeting date/time, approximate duration, and possibly the meeting location/link. Recommend a clear folder name, organized files, appropriate Viewer/Editor permissions, and testing access before sending.
